spans.s:
r. 1st cl. also read अलं (अलति-ते)
1 To adorn.
2 To be competent or able.
3 To prevent.

n. (-लं)
1 The sting in the tail of the scorpion.
2 Yellow orpiment.
E.
अल to adorn, &c. and अच् aff.

f. (-ल्ला)
A mother, in dramatic language.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Large, extensive.
n. (-लं)
Yellow orpiment.
E.
अल to adorn, in the causal form, अच् aff.

mn. (-कः-कं)
A curl.
m. (-कः)
A mad dog. See अलर्क.
f. (-का)
1 Alakā, the capital of

KUVERA.
2

A young girl from eight to ten years of age.
E.
अल to adorn, &c. वुन् affix, and fem. टाप्.

f. (-न्दा)
1 A young girl from eight to ten years old.
2 A river, the Alakanandā, a stream that runs from the Himālaya mountains, and falls into the Ganges near Srīnagar. It is also a name of the terrestrial Ganges.
E.
अलका, and नन्दा who delights, the final of the first dropped.

f. (-भा)
The capital of KUVERA.
E.
अलका and प्रभा what shines.

m. (-यः)
A plant, (Pentaptera tomentosa.)

f. (-तिः)
Rows of curls.
E.
अलक, and संहति collection. So अलकावली.

m. (-पः)
A name of KUVERA.
E.
अलका the city, and अधिप a ruler.

m. (-तिः)
KUVERA.
E.
लका, and अधिपति ruler.

m. (-न्तः)
A ringlet, the end of a curl.
E.
अलक, and अन्त end.

m. (-क्तः)
Lac, the red animal dye so called.
E.
अ neg. रक्त red, र being changed to ल; than what nothing is redder.

n. (-कं)
Lac, the dye; see the preceding.
E.
as before, कन् being added.

m. (-सः)
Liquefied lac dye.
E.
अलक्त, and रस juice.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Unfortunate, ill fated, having no good marks on the person.
2 Undefined.
n. (-णं)
1 The absence of auspicious marks.
2

Misfortune.
3

The want of any predicate or definition.
E.
अ priv. and लक्षण a mark.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Unmarked, having no particular mark.
2 Unobserved, unseen.
3 Undefined.
E.
अ neg. and लक्षित marked.

f. (-क्ष्मीः)
Misfortune, poverty.
E.
अ priv. and लक्ष्मी fortune.

mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं)
Undistinguishable, undefinable. So अलक्षणीय.

m. (-र्दः)
1 The black variety of the Cobra de Capello, (Coluber naga.)
2 A large black leech.
E.
अ neg. लग to be with or near, and क्विप् affix अलक; again अर्द to go, and अच् affix; not trailing its whole length upon the ground: also अलगर्द्ध.

m. (-र्द्दः)
A species of Cobra.
E.
see अलगर्द्द.

mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं)
Not joined or connected.
E.
अ neg. लग्न attached to.

mfn. (-घुः-घुः-घ्वी-घु)
1 Heavy, weighty.
2 Serious, solemn.
3 Violent, intense.
E.
अ neg. लघु light.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Solemnly pledged or promised.
E.
अलघु, and प्रतिज्ञा agreement.

m. (-लः)
A rock.
E.
अलघु, and उपल a stone.

m. (-ष्मा)
Intense heat.
E.
अलघु, and उष्मन् heat.

n. (-णं)
Ornament, decoration.
E.
अलम् ornament, and करण what makes.

Ornamented.
2

Fond of ornament.
E.
अलम् ornament, कर from कृ, and इष्णुच् aff.

mfn. (-र्ता-र्त्री-र्तृ)
Ornamented, ornamenting.
E.
अलम् as before, and कर्तृ who makes.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Competent to an act, skilful, clever.
E.
अलम् able, fit for, कर्म्म act, business, ख aff.

m. (-रः)
1 Ornament (of dress), trinkets, jewels, &c.
2 (Of language,) A figure or rhetorical expression.
3 The art of composition.
E.
अलम् ornament, कार what makes.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Unadorned.
E.
अलङ्कार, and हीन void of.

f. (-या)
Adorning, ornamenting.
E.
अलस्, and क्रिया act.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Ornamented, adorned, lit. or fig.
E.
अलम् as before, कृत made.

n. (-नं)
1 Not transgressing.
2 Not passing over or beyond.
E.
अ neg. लङ्घन crossing.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Impassable, not to be crossed.
2 Venerable, inviolable, not to be transgressed.
E.
अ neg. लङ्घनीय to be passed, also अलङ्घ्यः.

f. (-ता)
1 The state of not being passable.
2 Inviolability, respectability.
E.
तल् added to the last, also अलङ्घमीयत्वं.

mfn. (-ङ्घ्यः-ङ्घ्या-ङ्घ्यं)
1

Inviolable.
2

Impassable.
E.
अ neg. लङ्घ्य to be crossed.

f. (-ता)
1 Impassability, inaccessibility.
2

Superiority.
3

Authoritative or absolute rule.
E.
अलङ्घ्य not to be crossed or transgressed, तल् affix, also अलङ्घ्यत्वं.

mfn. (-ज्जः-ज्जा-ज्जं)
Shameless.
E.
अ neg. लज्जा shame. So अलज्जित.

f. (-जी)
Inflammation of the eye, at the edge of the cornea.

m. (-रः)
An earthen water jar.
E.
अलम् able, and जॄ to decay, also अलिञ्जर.

m. (-तिः)
A kind of song.
E.
अलम् ornament, and अति Uṇādi aff.

ind.
Quite enough, amply sufficient.
E.
अलं and तराम् aff.

mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं)
Unobtained.
E.
अ and लब्ध attained.

m. (-मः)
A great smoke.
E.
अलम् much, and धूम smoke.

mfn. (-भ्यः-भ्या-भ्यं)
Unattainable, unobtainable.
E.
अ neg. लभ्य to be got.

ind.
Having received or obtained.
E.
आङ् before लभि to gain, ल्यप् aff.

ind.
1

Ornament.
2

Enough, abundance.
3 Able, adequate or equal to.
4 Prohibition, no, not.
5 Unnecessary, no need of.
It is chiefly used in composition, as अलञ्जीविकः having enough for subsistence; अलन्दत्वा refusing to give; इत्यलम् enough; अलङ्कार ornament, &c.
E.
अल to adorn, &c. and अम् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Fit for a man, becoming a man.
E.
अलन्, पुरुष a man, and ख aff.

m. (-षः)
1 The palm of the hand with the fingers extended.
2 Vomiting, sickness.
3 The name of a Rākṣasa or goblin.
f. (-षा)
1 One of the Apsarasas or nymphs of

Svarga.
2

Madder, (Rubia manjith.)
3 A sort of sensitive plant.
4 A barrier, a line or any thing not to be crossed.
E.
अलम्, and बुस to injure, affix क.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Houseless, homeless.
E.
अ neg. and लय place of refuge.

m. (-यः)
A house, a dwelling, a receptacle, an asylum.
E.
आङ्, लीङ् to enfold, धञ् aff.

m. (-र्कः)
1 White swallow wort, (Calotropis gigantea alba.)
2 A mad dog or one rendered furious.
3 A fabulous animal, like a hog with eight legs.
4 An Asura changed to such an animal. Also अलर्क्क.
E.
अल to adorn, &c. क्विप् affix, and अर्क to inflame or heat.

ind.
A word of no import, occurring in the dialect or gibberish of Piśācas, a class of imps or goblins, when they are introduced in plays, &c.

n. (-लं)
A basin for water at the root of a tree.
E.
अ neg. लू to cut, and आल affix; also आलवाल.

n. (-लं)
A basin for water round the root of a tree.
E.
आङ् before लू to cut or dig, and आलच् aff.

n. (-कं)
See the preceding.
E.
as before, कन् added.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Lazy, idle, indolent.
m. (-सः)
1 Swelling of the feet in elephantiasis.
2 Chaps between the toes.
3 Name [] of a tree.
f. (-सा)
A creeping plant, (Cissus pedata.)
E.
अ neg. and लस to work, affix अच्.

m. (-सः)
Inflammation and abscess at the root of the tongue.
E.
अ neg. लास saliva.

mfn. (-सः-सी-सं)
Idle, slothful, lazy.
E.
अलस idle, अण् affix: see अलस.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Indolent.
m. (-कः)
Flatulence, Tympanitis, intumescence of the abdomen, with constipation and wind.
E.
कन् added to the last.

f. (-ता)
Idleness.
E.
अलस and तल् aff.

n. (-त्वं)
Idleness.
E.
अलस and त्वं aff.

f. (-णा)
A woman with languishing looks.
E.
अलस idle, and ईक्षणा looking.

n. (-तं)
A fire brand, whether burning or extinguished.
E.
अ neg. ला to take, and क्त aff.

n. (-तं)
A firebrand, a coal burning or extinguished.
E.
अलात and अण् aff.

f. (-बुः)
A long gourd. See the next word.

f. (-बूः)
The bottle gourd, (Cucurbita lagenaris.)
E.
अ neg. लब to sink, ऊ Uṇādi affix; म् is dropped, and the preceding vowel lengthened: what does not sink in water; floats, &c. are made of this gourd, especially when hollowed: also अलाबु and आलाबु.

f. (-बुः)
A pumpkin gourd: also आलाबू, अलाबु and अलाबू, q. v.

n. (-टं)
The down of the gourd.
E.
अलाबू and कटच् aff.

m. (-भः)
1 Non-acquirement, not getting.
2 Loss.
E.
अ neg. लाभ gain.

m. (-रः)
A door.
E.
अल able, and ऋ to go, अच् affix; by which one may go.

m. (-म्भः)
1 Slaughter, killing.
2 Embracing.
E.
आङ्, लभि to kill, affix धञ्.

mfn. (म्भ्यः-म्भ्या-म्भ्यं)
1 Fit or proper to be killed.
2 Obtainable, to be obtained.
E.
आङ् before लभि with ण्यत् aff.

m. (-म्बः)
1 A receptacle. a prop, an asylum or support.
2 Depending on or from.
3 A perpendicular.
E.
आङ् before लम्बि to go, affix घञ्.

n. (-नं)
1 Depending on or resting upon, hanging from.
2 The natural and necessary connexion of feeling with the cause by which it is excited.
3 Supporting, sustaining.
E.
आङ् and लवि to go, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Pendant, suspended, hanging from or on.
2 Supported, upheld.
3 Protected.
E.
आङ् before लवि to go, affix क्त.

mfn. (-म्बी-म्बिनी-म्बि)
1 Depending on or from, hanging from, &c.
2 Supporting, maintaining.
E.
आलम्ब support, and इनि aff.

Ugliness.
2

Insipidity.
E.
अ neg. लवण handsome, affix यञ्.

mfn. (-स्यः-सी-स्यं)
Idle, slothful, apathetic.
n. (-स्यं)
Idleness, sloth.
E.
अलस idle, and यञ् aff.

m. (-स्यः)
A crocodile.
E.
आल wide, large, and आस्य a mouth.

n. (-नं)
1 The post to which an elephant is tied.
2 The rope that ties him.
3 A fetter, a tie.
4 Tying, binding.
5 A rope or string.
E.
आङ् before ला to take, आला to tie or fasten, affix ल्युट्.

m. (-पः)
1 Speaking to, addressing, conversation.
2 Enumeration of the questions in an arithmetical or algebraic sum.
E.
आङ्, लप to speak, affix घञ्.

n. (-नं)
Speaking to, conversing with.
E.
आङ् before लप to speak, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be said or spoken.
2 To be spoken to or addressed.
E.
आङ् before लप to speak, अनीयर् affix; also आलाप्य.

mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि)
Who speaks or converses.
E.
आङ् before लप to speak, णिनि aff.

n. (-र्त्तं)
A fan made of cloth.
E.
आल orpiment, and आवर्त्त abode: stained or painted with some such substance.
